name: Interior Car Detailing
title: Interior Car Detailing in Cincinnati | 513 Auto Clean
meta: Interior car detailing at your Cincinnati home or work: Basic, Full and Full Interior + Steam, from {price:basic-interior}. See your total first. Pay when it's done.
h1: Book interior detailing in Cincinnati. We come to your driveway.
sub: Seats, carpet, mats and every crevice deep cleaned at your home or work, while you get on with your day. You see your full total, travel and tax included, before you book.
steps: Pick your package and vehicle size online. You see the full price, travel and tax included, before you book.
We show up at your home or work with our own supplies and equipment. An outdoor outlet helps if you have one.
We work through the car top to bottom: vacuum and blowout, then shampoo, surfaces, mats and the small details.
You look it over, then pay on site.
honest: a Full Interior lifts most dirt, hair and staining, but it doesn't repair tears, burns or worn fabric, and some old stains never fully come out. We tell you what to expect before we start.

faq.q: How much does interior car detailing cost in Cincinnati?
faq.a: For a small car, Basic Interior starts at {price:basic-interior}, Full Interior at {price:full-interior} and Full Interior + Steam at {price:full-steam-interior}. SUVs, trucks and vans cost a little more, and travel and sales tax are added. The booking form shows your full total before you book.

faq.q: How long does an interior detail take?
faq.a: On a small car, Basic Interior takes {time:basic-interior}, Full Interior {time:full-interior} and Full Interior + Steam {time:full-steam-interior}. Bigger vehicles, heavy pet hair or stains add time, and the booking form shows the time for your car.

faq.q: What's the difference between Basic and Full Interior?
faq.a: Basic Interior is a solid vacuum and wipe-down for a car that's mostly clean. Full Interior adds a shampoo scrub of the upholstery, leather conditioning, glass, door jambs and a brush detail of every crack and crevice. Full Interior + Steam also steam treats the upholstery and trim.
Yes. Full Interior vacuums up everyday hair. Hair woven deep into the carpet and seats needs the Pet Hair Removal add-on ({addon:pet-hair}), which goes after it in every crevice.

faq.q: Will stains and smells come out?
faq.a: We treat them, and most improve a lot, but some set-in stains and smells never fully come out. We tell you what to expect before we start. For a smell that lingers, the Ozone Odor Reset runs once the source is cleaned.

faq.q: Do you need my water or power?
faq.a: No. We bring what we need. An outdoor outlet helps if you have one.

faq.q: Do I need to be home?
faq.a: No, as long as we can get into the car. You can leave us the keys and go about your day.
When it's done. You look the car over first, then pay on site.
